
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/gocodinginmyway/p/19796495" title="发布于 2026-03-30 16:34">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">YOLO-Master 与 YOLO26 开始</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>2026 年初，YOLO 迎来了新变化，都非常亮眼 👍</p>
<p>一是 <a href="https://github.com/Tencent/YOLO-Master" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">YOLO-Master</a>：引入了 ES-MoE，让计算更智能。会依据输入自适应做计算，不再是静态的。</p>
<p>二是 <a href="https://docs.ultralytics.com/zh/models/yolo26/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">YOLO26</a>：更简化的设计，直接端到端出检测结果。不用再搞后处理了呢，利于边缘做部署。</p>
<p>既然 YOLO 上新了，那一起玩一玩吧 ☺️</p>
<ul>
<li>体验 YOLO-Master: <a href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/gatilin/YOLO-Master-WebUI-Demo" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://huggingface.co/spaces/gatilin/YOLO-Master-WebUI-Demo</a></li>
<li>体验 YOLO26: <a href="https://platform.ultralytics.com/ultralytics/yolo26" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://platform.ultralytics.com/ultralytics/yolo26</a></li>
</ul>
<p>以下则是动手实践了呢。</p>
<ul>
<li>代码: <a href="https://github.com/ikuokuo/start-deep-learning" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ikuokuo/start-deep-learning</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="yolo-master">YOLO-Master</h2>
<h3 id="环境">环境</h3>
<p>准备 Conda 环境，</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">conda create -n yolom python=3.12
conda activate yolom

# Install PyTorch (CPU version)
pip install torch torchvision
# Install PyTorch with CUDA (version &lt;= nvidia-smi shown)
#  https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally
pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130
</code></pre>
<p>准备 YOLO-Master，</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># Clone the repository
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Tencent/YOLO-Master
cd YOLO-Master

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install -e .

# Optional: Install FlashAttention for faster training (CUDA required)
#   https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention
pip install flash_attn
</code></pre>
<p>准备模型，</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 获取模型，YOLO-Master-EsMoE-N
wget https://huggingface.co/gatilin/YOLO-Master-ckpts-v0/resolve/main/YOLO-Master-EsMoE-N/YOLO-Master-EsMoE-N.pt?download=true
ln -s YOLO-Master-EsMoE-N.pt yolo_master_n.pt
</code></pre>
<h3 id="推理">推理</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">from ultralytics import YOLO

# 加载模型，Nano 版
model = YOLO("yolo_master_n.pt")
# model = YOLO("runs/detect/train/weights/best.pt")

# 检测图像
results = model.predict("data/dog.jpg")
results[0].show()

# 保存结果
results[0].save("result/dog.jpg")
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2049757/202603/2049757-20260330163404532-1439267696.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="训练">训练</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">from ultralytics import YOLO

# 加载模型，从 YAML 构建（从零开始）
# model = YOLO('cfg/models/master/v0/det/yolo-master-n.yaml')
# 加载模型，Nano 版（全量微调）
model = YOLO("yolo_master_n.pt")

# 训练模型，用 COCO8 数据集测试
#   结果在 runs/detect/train10/weights/best.pt
results = model.train(
    data='coco8.yaml',  # data='coco.yaml',
    epochs=100,         # epochs=600,
    batch=8,            # batch=256,
    imgsz=640,
    device="0",         # device="0,1,2,3",  # 如果使用多 GPU
    scale=0.5,
    mosaic=1.0,
    mixup=0.0,
    copy_paste=0.1
)
</code></pre>
<p>YOLO-Master 还可以 LoRA 微调 ☺️</p>
<h2 id="yolo26">YOLO26</h2>
<h3 id="环境-1">环境</h3>
<p>准备 Conda 环境，</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">conda create -n yolo26 python=3.12
conda activate yolo26

# Install PyTorch (CPU version)
pip install torch torchvision
# Install PyTorch with CUDA (version &lt;= nvidia-smi shown)
#  https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally
pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130
</code></pre>
<p>准备 YOLO26，</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># Install ultralytics package
pip install -U ultralytics

# Install dependencies
pip install faster-coco-eval
</code></pre>
<h3 id="推理-1">推理</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">from ultralytics import YOLO

# 加载模型，Nano 版
model = YOLO("yolo26n.pt")
# model = YOLO("runs/detect/train/weights/best.pt")

# 检测图像
results = model.predict("data/dog.jpg")
results[0].show()

# 保存结果
results[0].save("result/dog.jpg")
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2049757/202603/2049757-20260330163420973-857255115.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="训练-1">训练</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">from ultralytics import YOLO

# 加载模型，Nano 版
model = YOLO("yolo26n.pt")

# 训练模型，用 COCO8 数据集测试
#   结果在 runs/detect/train/weights/best.pt
results = model.train(data="coco8.yaml", epochs=100, imgsz=640)
</code></pre>
<h2 id="结语">结语</h2>
<p>YOLO 训练越来越简便了呢，部署仍旧看平台咯。</p>
